news.headline: Candidates clash over cost of living in French presidential debate
news.summary: Five of the frontrunners for the French presidential election lined up for the second of this year's debates on Monday night. In an often-rowdy debate, candidates clashed over counterproposals to raise and cut taxes and slash public spending.

news.headline: China charges veteran nuclear expert Gu Jun with taking ‘huge’ bribes
news.summary:
China has charged a former senior nuclear industry executive with bribery, marking the latest downfall in its sweeping anti-corruption crackdown targeting the military and defence sectors.
Gu Jun, former general manager of state-owned giant China National Nuclear Corporation (CNNC), will stand trial
